PSet 3 AI learning support beyond confidence
11
Learning support
Evidence from the chat logs
Conceptual help
60.7% of IDs (37/61) asked at least one concept, reasoning or equation question.
Repeated engagement
54.1% of IDs (33/61) had two or more recorded AI exchanges.
Reasoning follow-ups
At least 14.8% of IDs (9/61) probed earlier explanations in 13 manually reviewed follow-up questions. 
For example, a user corrected velocity from 1.2 to 2.7 m/s and pressure from 125.5 to 122.575 kPa. 
144 exchanges across 61 anonymous IDs
